app.title: Fourier Sketch — Epicycle Diagnostic
cli.description: Render the canonical Fourier epicycle diagnostic.
cli.freehand_description: Draw a local stroke and animate its Fourier epicycles.
cli.edge_description: Detect a threshold boundary or OpenCV Canny edge intermediate from a local PNG or JPEG.
cli.edge_output_exists: The output already exists; use --overwrite to replace it.
cli.help.closed: Treat the captured stroke as a closed curve.
cli.help.headless: Render a PNG without opening a window.
cli.help.resampling: Curve resampling method: uniform_index or arc_length.
cli.invalid_parameters: Invalid diagnostic parameters. Check frames, harmonics, speed, locale, and destination.
cli.io_failed: Could not write the diagnostic PNG.
cli.image_description: Safely preprocess a local PNG or JPEG into diagnostic grayscale or binary output.
cli.image_output_exists: The output already exists; use --overwrite to replace it.
cli.help.canny_gradient: OpenCV Canny gradient norm: l1 or l2.
cli.help.canny_high: OpenCV Canny high threshold from 1 to 255.
cli.help.canny_low: OpenCV Canny low threshold from 0 to 254.
cli.help.denoise: Bounded denoise mode: none or median_3.
cli.help.image_input: Local PNG or JPEG source file.
cli.help.image_stage: Intermediate to export: grayscale or binary.
cli.help.overwrite: Explicitly replace an existing output file.
edge.error.backend_failure: The selected edge backend failed its execution contract.
edge.error.backend_unavailable: The selected Canny backend is unavailable; no other algorithm was substituted.

edge.error.invalid_parameters: Edge parameters are invalid. Check algorithm-specific thresholds, aperture, gradient, and connectivity.
freehand.input.title: Draw a stroke
freehand.instructions: Drag with the left mouse button. R resets; Esc cancels.
freehand.output.empty: Complete a stroke to start the epicycle timeline.
freehand.output.title: Epicycle result
